reasoning_content:
Docker daemon is running (Server section present). The error exit code 141 is just SIGPIPE from head. Good.

Now let's run the installation. `make run` runs `docker compose -f deployment/docker-compose.yml up --build`. This is a foreground command that will build the image (may take long) and run. We have 600s timeout per command. The build may take longer than 600s especially since it installs paddlepaddle, paddleocr, downloads models.

Better approach: build image first in background or use `docker compose build` with a longer strategy. But commands have fixed 600s timeout. Building could exceed that. We can run the build in background with nohup and poll.

Let me set up proxy environment as the Makefile expects. Check env vars.

action.command: env | grep -i proxy; echo "---"; make --version | head -1; echo "---disk---"; df -h / ; echo "---mem---"; free -h
